content.purpose: A Institute of Secretariat Training & Management(ISTM) & Wadhwani Foundation Production
organisation: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management
content.description: This course is designed to educate all employees on the critical issue of preventing sexual harassment in the workplace. It provides a detailed examination of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. The content addresses the importance of creating a safe, respectful, and professional environment for all, which is fundamental to organizational health and employee well-being. Key learning areas include a clear definition of sexual harassment with real-world examples, the distinction between 'quid pro quo' and a 'hostile work environment', and the legal obligations placed upon employers. Learners will gain a thorough understanding of the complaint mechanism, including the formation and functions of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), the step-by-step inquiry process, and the potential penalties for non-compliance. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to identify inappropriate behavior, understand their rights and duties, and contribute to a culture of zero tolerance for sexual harassment, ensuring a legally compliant and secure workplace.
content.name: Prevention of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace

organisation: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
content.description: Healthcare facilities present unique and complex challenges for fire safety due to the presence of vulnerable patients, high-value equipment, and combustible materials. This course is designed to equip healthcare professionals, administrators, and support staff with the critical knowledge and skills to manage these risks effectively. The curriculum delves into the fundamental causes of hospital fires, different fire classifications, and the proper use of fire suppression equipment like extinguishers and alarm systems. A significant focus is placed on proactive and reactive strategies, including the development and implementation of robust fire safety and evacuation plans, with special attention to patient prioritization and movement challenges. The course also covers the importance of regulatory compliance with codes like the National Building Code (NBC) 2016 and the necessity of conducting regular mock drills to test and refine emergency procedures. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to lead fire safety initiatives, mitigate risks, and foster a resilient safety culture within their facilities.
content.name: Fire Safety in Healthcare Facilities

content.description: यह पाठ्यक्रम भारत में नागरिक सुरक्षा के महत्वपूर्ण ढांचे की विस्तृत समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह बताता है कि कैसे नागरिक सुरक्षा संगठन आपातकालीन स्थितियों और आपदाओं के दौरान नागरिकों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कार्य करता है। पाठ्यक्रम मुख्यालय सेवाओं, संचार, वार्डन सेवाओं, हताहत सेवाओं, अग्निशमन, बचाव, और आपूर्ति श्रृंखला प्रबंधन सहित विभिन्न प्रभागों के कार्यों का गहन विश्लेषण करता है। शिक्षार्थी जानेंगे कि ये सभी सेवाएं संकट के समय जीवन और संपत्ति की रक्षा के लिए कैसे समन्वय करती हैं। यह पाठ्यक्रम आम नागरिकों, स्वयंसेvकों और सरकारी अधिकारियों को आपदाओं के लिए तैयार रहने, प्रभावी ढंग से प्रतिक्रिया करने और समुदाय के लचीलेपन में योगदान करने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान से लैस करेगा। इसका उद्देश्य शिक्षार्थियों में सामाजिक जिम्मेदारी की भावना पैदा करना और उन्हें अपने समुदायों को सुरक्षित बनाने में सक्रिय भूमिका निभाने के लिए प्रेरित करना है।
content.name: Civil Defence Services (नागरिक सुरक्षा सेवाएँ)

content.purpose: स्वच्छता ही सेवा - 2024 पर प्रशिक्षण मॉड्यूल
organisation: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
content.description: यह प्रशिक्षण पाठ्यक्रम 'स्वच्छता ही सेवा (SHS) 2024' अभियान की विस्तृत जानकारी प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, जिसे आवासन एवं शहरी कार्य मंत्रालय (MoHUA) द्वारा शुरू किया गया है। इस वर्ष की थीम 'स्वभाव स्वच्छता - संस्कार स्वच्छता' है, जो स्वच्छता को हमारे दैनिक जीवन और सांस्कृतिक मूल्यों का एक अभिन्न अंग बनाने पर जोर देती है। पाठ्यक्रम में अभियान के तीन प्रमुख स्तंभों पर चर्चा की गई है: स्वच्छता के लिए श्रमदान, जन भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देना, और सफाई मित्रों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करना। शिक्षार्थी समझेंगे कि कैसे विभिन्न हितधारक, जैसे कि मंत्रालय, शहरी स्थानीय निकाय, नागरिक समूह और निजी संगठन, 'कचरा मुक्त भारत' के दृष्टिकोण को साकार करने के लिए मिलकर काम कर सकते हैं। यह पाठ्यक्रम प्रतिभागियों को अपने समुदायों में स्वच्छता गतिविधियों को प्रभावी ढंग से आयोजित करने और एक स्थायी व्यवहार परिवर्तन लाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करेगा।
content.name: स्वच्छता ही सेवा - 2024 पर प्रशिक्षण मॉड्यूल

content.purpose: Training Module on Swachata Hi Seva - 2024
organisation: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
content.description: This training module provides a comprehensive overview of the Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) 2024 campaign, a nationwide initiative to promote cleanliness and sanitation. The course delves into this year's theme, 'Swabhav Swachhata - Sanskaar Swachhata,' which emphasizes fostering cleanliness as a natural habit and cultural value. Learners will explore the three core pillars of the campaign: transforming Cleanliness Target Units (CTUs), encouraging mass public participation (Jan Bhagidari), and ensuring the welfare of sanitation workers through SafaiMitra Suraksha Shivirs. The content is structured to equip all stakeholders, from central ministry officials to urban local body staff and citizens, with the knowledge to actively participate in and sustain impactful cleanliness drives. By completing this course, participants will understand how to contribute to the larger vision of a 'Garbage Free India' by adopting and advocating for responsible sanitation and waste management practices in their communities.
content.name: Training Module on Swachata Hi Seva - 2024

content.instructions:
The reforms/changes introduced in Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 have been covered in this course. The course provides a general overview of reforms, touches upon the changes introduced in ‘offence relating to woman and child’, deals with reforms in ‘offences affecting human body’, and discusses the changes with respect to ‘offence against the State’, ‘Contempt of the lawful authority of public servants’, ‘Offence relating to religion’ etc. The course also examines the reforms in the ‘offence against property’ and the punishment related reforms.

Target audience: Criminal law touches upon life of every individual. Any change in this domain needs to be properly understood and appreciated. The officers of law enforcement agencies (LEAs) dealing with these laws on daily basis are the primary target group, however, other public servants may also be benefited with this course.

Learning outcomes:

  1. To acquaint the learners with the changes introduced in the IPC.
  2. To expose the learners to the deleted offences and the newly introduced offences in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
  3. To expose the learners the underlying philosophy of punishment and the related reforms.

Pre-requisite: A basic understanding of the provisions of the erstwhile Indian Penal Code, 1860 is required.
content.description: The major criminal laws have seen an overall change with the introduction of three new criminal laws viz. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 to replace the existing Indian Penal Code, 1860, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Indian Evidence Act, 1872 respectively. This course offers a overview of the changes introduced in the Indian Penal Code and deals with offence and punishment related reforms.
content.name: Introduction To Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023

content.instructions:
The course on the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 provides a general overview of reforms introduced in the criminal procedure. The course deals with pre-investigation procedure- FIR, Complaint etc. and examines the investigation related reforms like arrest, search seizure, recording of statement, police report etc. The course further deals with post investigation and pre-trial related changes which includes the stage of cognizance, committal, supply of copies, discharge and framing of charge and explains the trial related reforms introduced in all four types of trial- Sessions trial, warrant trial, summons trial and summary trial including the changes introduced in plea bargaining. The course also covers victim perspective, bail related reforms and other reforms/changes.

Target audience: Criminal law touches upon life of every individual. Any change in this domain needs to be properly understood and appreciated. The officers of law enforcement agencies (LEAs) dealing with these laws on daily basis are the primary target group, however, other public servants may also be benefited with this course.

Learning outcomes:

  1. To acquaint the learners with the changes introduced in the criminal procedure.
  2. To acquaint the learners with the changes in the modes of crime reporting.
  3. To explain the learners the special rules of use of forensic, audio-video electronic means and videography.
  4. To explain the learners the introduction of timelines at various stages of proceedings and processes.

Pre-requisite: A basic understanding of the provisions of the erstwhile Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is required.
content.purpose: To Replace Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
content.description: The major criminal laws have seen an overall change with the introduction of three new criminal laws viz. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 to replace the existing Indian Penal Code, 1860, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Indian Evidence Act, 1872 respectively. This course offers a overview of the changes introduced in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and deals with the procedural reforms relating to crime reporting, investigation, prosecution and trial of offences.
content.name: Introduction to Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023

content.instructions:
The Course on Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 explains the reforms made in the law of evidence. The course provides the changes introduced in the domain of electronic evidence and covers all other changes introduced in the Adhiniyam.

Target audience: Criminal law touches upon life of every individual. Any change in this domain needs to be properly understood and appreciated. The officers of law enforcement agencies (LEAs) dealing with these laws on daily basis are the primary target group, however, other public servants may also be benefited with this course.

Learning outcomes:

  1. To acquaint the learners with the changes introduced in the evidence law.
  2. To understand the changes introduced with respect to the electronic evidence.

Pre-requisite: A basic understanding of the provisions of the erstwhile Indian Evidence Act, 1872 is required.
content.description: The major criminal laws have seen an overall change with the introduction of three new criminal laws viz. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 to replace the existing Indian Penal Code, 1860, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Indian Evidence Act, 1872 respectively. This course offers a overview of the changes introduced in the Indian Evidence Act and deals with the evidence related reforms specifically dealing with admissibility and appreciation of electronic evidence.
content.name: Introduction to Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023

content.description: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the models and systems that define effective public governance. It addresses common challenges within government administration, such as conflicting objectives and a lack of clear accountability, which often lead to a significant 'implementation gap' between policy promises and delivery. The curriculum is structured around the '12 habits of an effective government,' offering a deep dive into creating and sustaining high-performing public systems. Learners will explore the nuances of performance measurement, including the development of appropriate metrics, weighted success indicators, and multi-point rating scales. The course emphasizes the importance of performance agreements, outcome-based budgeting, and integrating HR and financial systems with performance goals. By analyzing real-world examples from countries like New Zealand, Malaysia, and India, participants will learn how to apply these frameworks to foster a culture of accountability, improve implementation, and ultimately drive national development.
content.name: Public Governance Models

content.purpose: Data Driven Decision Making For Government
content.description: In an era where data is crucial for effective governance, this course provides a foundational understanding of Data-Driven Decision-Making (DDDM) for government professionals. It addresses the growing need for data literacy within public administration, exploring how to build a robust digital infrastructure to support anticipatory and evidence-based decisions. The curriculum delves into the core concepts of data science, analytics, and the practical use of visualization tools to uncover patterns and insights from data. Participants will learn about the nuances of data collection and feature engineering through a practical case study. By the end of this course, officials will be equipped to identify work-related problems where data analytics can offer a viable solution, appreciate the potential and limitations of emerging technologies, and ultimately contribute to stronger, more efficient public service delivery.
content.name: Data Driven Decision Making For Government

content.description: This introductory course is designed for professionals seeking to understand the essential principles of public policy and its critical role in modern governance. The curriculum begins by defining public policy and illustrating its relevance in everyday life, from traffic laws to public health. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to exploring the economic foundations of policy intervention. You will learn to identify and analyze various market failures, such as the challenges in providing public goods, the societal costs of negative externalities, and the market distortions caused by adverse selection and moral hazard. The course uses fundamental economic concepts like demand, supply, and surplus to explain how policy choices are evaluated. Through a series of real-world and theoretical examples, learners will grasp the complexities of policy design, implementation, and enforcement. By the end of this course, you will have a structured framework for thinking critically about public problems and the potential of policy to create desirable societal outcomes.
content.name: Fundamentals of Public Policy

content.purpose: Streamlining daily office work with recent updates in AI tools
content.description: In an era of rapid digital transformation, artificial intelligence is reshaping the professional landscape. This course is designed for beginners and offers a comprehensive introduction to the capabilities of generative AI through two of its most prominent tools: Google Bard and ChatGPT. The program begins by explaining the core concepts of AI and its relevance to modern governance and public service. You will learn to navigate the features of Google Bard, including its ability to draft emails, generate ideas, and create content. A significant portion of the course is dedicated to mastering ChatGPT's powerful Code Interpreter plugin. You will gain hands-on experience uploading data files, instructing the AI to perform complex analysis, generate visualizations like charts and graphs, and clean datasets. The course also addresses the critical aspects of using these tools responsibly, covering privacy concerns and ethical considerations. By the end of this course, you will be able to confidently apply these AI tools to automate tasks, derive meaningful insights from data, and ultimately improve your professional effectiveness.
content.name: AI Using Google Bard and ChatGPT for Beginners

content.description: This comprehensive course provides a foundational understanding of Microsoft Excel, an essential tool for data management and analysis in any professional setting. The curriculum is designed to guide beginners through the core functionalities of the application, starting with navigating the interface, understanding the ribbon menu, and working with worksheets, rows, and columns. Learners will gain hands-on experience with entering, editing, and formatting data, including text, numbers, and currencies. The course delves into the power of Excel formulas, covering essential arithmetic operations such as sum, average, multiplication, and division. It also introduces methods for organizing large datasets through sorting, filtering, and using features like Freeze Panes for better navigation. Furthermore, participants will learn to visualize data by creating basic charts and pivot tables, transforming raw numbers into meaningful insights. By the end of this course, learners will be equipped to create, manage, and analyze spreadsheets with confidence, enhancing their productivity and data literacy skills for various official tasks.
content.name: Microsoft Excel for Beginners

content.description: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the essential principles of Administrative Law, designed specifically for government functionaries. It addresses the critical need for public servants to operate within a defined legal and ethical framework. The curriculum begins by defining the nature and scope of administrative law and its relevance in modern governance. A significant portion is dedicated to 'subordinate legislation,' explaining the process by which the executive creates detailed rules under the authority of parliamentary acts, and the legislative and judicial controls that ensure this power is not misused. The course then thoroughly examines the 'Principles of Natural Justice,' including the right to a fair hearing, the rule against bias, and the requirement for 'speaking orders.' Upon completion, learners will be equipped to make legally sound administrative decisions, ensure procedural fairness in their work, and contribute to a more transparent, accountable, and just public administration system, thereby minimizing legal challenges and enhancing public trust.
content.name: Basics of Administrative Law

content.purpose: Everyone should be safe to study, discover and enjoy the internet
content.description: In an increasingly digital world, understanding how to protect oneself online is a critical skill for everyone. This course, 'Fundamentals of Digital Safety and Online Security,' serves as an essential introduction to safe internet practices. It is designed for a general audience with no prior technical knowledge. The curriculum covers key areas such as identifying common threats like phishing and malware, creating strong passwords, managing privacy settings, and practicing safe browsing habits. Through a series of practical tips and clear guidance, learners will understand the importance of digital hygiene. The course concludes with interactive quizzes to reinforce learning and check comprehension, ensuring that participants can confidently apply these safety essentials to their daily online activities, both personal and professional. Upon completion, learners will be better equipped to safeguard their digital footprint and contribute to a more secure online environment for all.
content.name: Digital safety essentials

content.description: This course provides a foundational understanding of project management, essential for public sector professionals tasked with delivering projects on time and within budget. It is designed to equip learners with the core knowledge needed to navigate the entire project lifecycle. The curriculum covers critical stages, including project initiation, where you will learn to define goals and identify stakeholders. You will explore comprehensive project planning, covering scope definition, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk assessment. The course delves into the execution phase, focusing on team leadership and progress monitoring, and concludes with the procedures for effective project closure. Participants will also be introduced to key knowledge areas such as risk management, project finance, and the work breakdown structure. By the end of this session, you will be empowered with the practical knowledge to initiate, plan, execute, and close projects with greater confidence and efficiency.
content.name: Introduction: Basics of Project Management

content.description: Embark on a journey to operational excellence with this fundamental course on Six Sigma. This program is designed for professionals seeking to understand and apply a structured, data-driven approach to eliminate defects and improve process performance. The course begins by defining Six Sigma and its critical role in modern business process re-engineering, tracing its evolution from manufacturing to a wide array of service industries. You will gain a thorough understanding of the five-phase DMAIC methodology, which forms the backbone of any Six Sigma project. Each phase—Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, and Control—is explored in detail, highlighting key activities, objectives, and the specific statistical and qualitative tools used, such as Project Charters, SIPOC, FMEA, and Control Charts. The curriculum places a strong emphasis on practical application, teaching you how to use statistical analysis to identify root causes of process variation and implement sustainable solutions. By the end of this course, you will be equipped to contribute to quality improvement initiatives, reduce operational costs, and enhance customer satisfaction within your organization.
content.name: Six Sigma Fundamentals

content.description: In an era of complex public sector challenges, 'Introduction to Design Thinking for Innovation' offers a structured framework for creative problem-solving. This course is designed to introduce government professionals to a powerful methodology that places citizen needs at the heart of policy and service design. You will learn why design thinking is crucial for fostering innovation and how its principles can be applied in a science and technology-driven governance landscape. The curriculum covers the complete design thinking lifecycle, including understanding user needs through empathy, defining problems, ideating creative solutions, building prototypes, and testing them. Participants will gain insights into practical tools and techniques that can be immediately applied to their work. By the end of this course, you will be prepared to approach challenges with a more collaborative, experimental, and citizen-centric perspective, driving meaningful improvements in public services.
content.name: Design Thinking

content.purpose: कार्यस्थल पर महिलाओं के यौन उत्पीड़न की रोकथाम
content.description: यह पाठ्यक्रम भारत में कार्यस्थल पर यौन उत्पीड़न की रोकथाम के लिए कानूनी ढांचे की व्यापक समझ प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह 'कार्यस्थल पर महिलाओं का यौन उत्पीड़न (रोकथाम, निषेध और निवारण) अधिनियम, 2013' (POSH Act) के प्रमुख प्रावधानों पर केंद्रित है। पाठ्यक्रम यौन उत्पीड़न के विभिन्न रूपों की पहचान करने, 'क्विड प्रो क्वो' और 'शत्रुतापूर्ण कार्य वातावरण' के बीच अंतर करने में शिक्षार्थियों की मदद करेगा। इसमें आंतरिक शिकायत समिति (ICC) और स्थानीय शिकायत समिति (LCC) की स्थापना, भूमिकाओं और जिम्मेदारियों को विस्तार से behandelt किया गया है। शिक्षार्थी शिकायत दर्ज करने की प्रक्रिया, जांच प्रक्रिया और दोषी पाए जाने पर होने वाले दंडात्मक परिणामों के बारे में जानेंगे। पाठ्यक्रम का उद्देश्य कर्मचारियों को उनके अधिकारों के बारे में जागरूक करना और नियोक्ताओं को एक सुरक्षित, सम्मानजनक और भय-मुक्त कार्य वातावरण बनाने के लिए उनकी कानूनी जिम्मेदारियों को समझने में सक्षम बनाना है।
content.name: कार्यस्थल पर महिलाओं के यौन उत्पीड़न की रोकथाम
